title: "RKR Newsletter Dashboard"
subtitle: "Does a better designed newsletter section bring more diners to The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch?"
---

## What This Dashboard Answers

The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch (RKR) is promoted every week in *The Collins Concierge*, the Collins College newsletter. My MSDM culminating project asks a simple business question:

> **If we change how RKR's section looks, do more readers click "Reserve a Table" and book on OpenTable?**

<a class="cta" href="rkr-dashboard.html">Open the interactive dashboard →</a>

## How the Test Works

The project runs in two phases during the 2026 to 2027 school year:

1. **Fall: button placement.** Move the "Reserve a Table" button to the upper left of RKR's section and compare against past issues.
2. **Spring: image vs. video.** Keep the button fixed and split each issue so half of readers see an image and half see a video.

## What You Can Do in the Dashboard

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Overview
Headline numbers for every tracked issue: open rate, "Reserve a Table" click rate, and OpenTable reservations, plus a week by week trend.

### Fall Test
Compares the upper-left button against the baseline, with a two-proportion test to check whether the lift is more than chance.

### Spring Test
Compares image and video formats side by side using the same click and reservation measures.

### Data
A searchable, sortable table of every issue so you can check any number yourself.

:::

## Key Measures

| Measure | How it is calculated | Why it matters |
|---------|---------------------|----------------|
| Open rate | Opens ÷ recipients | Shows whether readers see the newsletter at all |
| Reserve click rate | "Reserve a Table" clicks ÷ opens | Shows whether RKR's section earns attention |
| Reservations | OpenTable bookings attributed to the newsletter | The business outcome RKR cares about |

::: {.callout-note}
## About the data
Real issue data is still being collected. The dashboard currently runs on an **illustrative sample** (`data/rkr_newsletter.csv`) built to match the test design. Swapping in real data only requires replacing that one CSV file; every chart and statistic updates on the next render.
:::
